job.name: ig16_host_b
job.meaning: мужчина ~35, рыжеватая аккуратная борода, графитовая рубашка на пуговицах, белый диван-букле, тёмно-синяя стена, абстрактная картина в тёплых тонах
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a Russian man about 35 with short light-brown hair and a neat reddish beard, a charcoal grey button-up shirt with rolled sleeves. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium shot from mid-thigh up, he sits relaxed on a sofa slightly turned, both shoulders and hands inside the frame, a black podcast microphone on a boom arm near his face on the side (not covering the mouth), face large and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge, looking slightly off-camera toward an unseen interviewer, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, one hand in a calm open gesture, sincere thoughtful expression, NO broad smile. Look: a real frame from a high-end podcast camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark. Background: a modern podcast studio with a deep navy wall, a white boucle sofa, a framed abstract painting in terracotta and sand tones, soft daylight.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary man (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real. For a podcast he looks slightly off-camera at the interviewer — this is intended.

attempts.issue: Subject is looking away from the camera and microphone obstructs the subject
Subject is not facing forward or looking into the camera; remove the microphone.
Face is turned away; subject must be front-facing and look directly into the camera
